paragraphs: InVeris Training Solutions sells virtual weapons and scenario training systems to public safety and defense customers. It also sells live fire training systems and range equipment to defense, public safety and commercial buyers. The site points to 98 years of technical evolution behind the product line.

On the virtual side, the catalog starts with BlueFire small arms simulators. Heavy weapon simulators and a Reconfigurable Desktop Trainer fill out that range. For defense ranges it sells live fire training systems and target solutions, including stationary and moving infantry and armor targets. Public safety and commercial ranges get bullet traps, ballistic baffles and shooting stalls, including the GranTrap bullet trap and SafeZone shooting stalls. Both catalogs list a Location Of Miss & Hit target system, and the site offers a Build Your Own Range section.

The company gives its address as 1320 Ridgeland Parkway in Alpharetta, Georgia. A January 2026 press release announces the relaunch of Caswell as a live fire brand under InVeris, coinciding with a 100th anniversary. For agencies that need to fund a new training facility, the site offers Police Grant Help. Sales run through regional sales reps and an online store, and the company exhibits at tradeshows.
